input.quote: (a) This Agreement is governed in all respects by the laws of the State of Delaware without giving effect to its conflict of laws principles. Each Party hereby irrevocably submits for all disputes to the exclusive jurisdiction and venue of the state and federal courts located in New York, New York.
input.rationale: Section 14(a) picks Delaware law (an accepted fallback law) but pairs it with New York courts, so it matches neither the preferred position (New York law plus New York County courts) nor the fallback (Delaware/California law with the corresponding courts). More materially, Section 8 imposes mandatory AAA arbitration for "[a]ny controversy or claim arising out of or relating to this Agreement", which directly contradicts the exclusive court jurisdiction in Section 14(a) and means the contract does not deliver a court forum at all; the fallback forum element therefore fails on a material term. The seat is domestic AAA rather than a foreign arbitration, so this is a deviation rather than walk-away. Our redline makes New York the governing law (matching both parties' home jurisdiction and the venue already agreed) and conforms Section 8 to exclusive merits resolution in the state and federal courts in New York County, retaining the customary temporary-injunctive-relief carve-out. The jury waiver and one-year limitation sentences in Section 8, and the fee-shifting reference in 14(d), are left untouched as outside this rule.

proposal.summary: New York law; disputes resolved exclusively in New York County courts instead of mandatory AAA arbitration
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We change the governing law to New York, which is our preferred position and matches both parties' home jurisdiction, and we conform Section 8 so disputes go to the state and federal courts in New York County (with the customary temporary-injunctive-relief carve-out) rather than to mandatory AAA arbitration, which today contradicts the exclusive court jurisdiction already agreed in Section 14(a). Delaware or California law with the corresponding courts would be our fallback.

ops.oldText: Any controversy or claim arising out of or relating to this Agreement, or the breach thereof, shall be settled by arbitration administered by the American Arbitration Association under its Commercial Arbitration Rules, and judgment on the award rendered by the arbitrator(s) may be entered in any court having jurisdiction thereof
ops.newText: Any controversy or claim arising out of or relating to this Agreement, or the breach thereof, shall be resolved exclusively on the merits in the state and federal courts located in New York County, New York, provided that either Party may seek temporary injunctive relief in any court of competent jurisdiction

mappings.element: New York law governs the Agreement.
State and federal courts in New York County have exclusive jurisdiction over the merits, subject only to temporary injunctive relief elsewhere.
